arguments.prompt: Use case illustration-story. DRAW an actual two-panel grayscale staging storyboard, each panel wide landscape, stacked vertically. No text. Input photos 1-2 are Neet standing visible anatomy, 3-4 Buddy standing visible anatomy, 5 Buddy compact curl POSE ONLY; use other photos for hidden construction. No calibrated dimensions. Neet full narrow torso, fine long legs, large broad triangular ears, tiny tail nub, projecting muzzle. Buddy moderately elongated continuous torso/neck, substantial legs, real clearance, modest head, hanging ear flaps and regional muzzle/brow furnishings. Short smooth body contours. Panel TOP: Istanbul airport lounge. Buddy curls comfortably on a broad low gray recliner, his whole C-shaped body supported on seat, nose tucked just beneath one front paw; paws connect naturally, hindlegs folded. Neet stands with all four feet on floor beside the recliner, nose aimed to an inviting buffet in background at right, ears alert. Conflict: sleep versus food. Windows show airport apron, no invented skyline. Panel BOTTOM: closer low viewpoint at lounge towel counter, after shower. Neet stands on floor on four legs, tiny body wrapped loosely in a white towel; towel edge has slipped OVER one forepaw (fabric covers that paw, not a fifth leg). Neet freezes, ears erect, chin slightly lowered, trying to preserve dignity. Heather crouches beside him, fully dressed colorful blouse and trousers, one hand gently lifting towel edge away from trapped paw. Human physical appearance provisional, cropped face. A private shower room's opaque outer door behind is closed. No naked person, no visible shower body. Clear canine connected bodies, correct limb roots/weight support/occlusion, full scene drawn not schematic. No engraved hair or dense crosshatching.
